name: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

angles.text: The parcel holds a replica Ironforge air rifle, honoring the famed firearms and mechanical craft of Khaz Modan.
Tinkers and gunsmiths may appreciate the intricate firearm model. An indifferent courier brought it, and it nearly ended up at the bottom of the ocean.

faq.answer: The courier and original sender gave no name or explanation. The caretaker says someone left a parcel addressed to you, insisted you would claim it, then vanished before questions could be asked.

aliases: what was going to happen to the package
faq.answer: The parcel nearly went into the sea with the nightly garbage. The caretaker said they do not keep things in storage and routinely throw unwanted clutter into the ocean.
faq.q: What was almost done to the package?

faq.answer: The parcel contains a Replica Ironforge Air Rifle, left for you as a tribute to dwarven firearm design.
The caretaker does not keep mail or store parcels. The courier hurried away before there was a chance to refuse the delivery.
faq.q: Why was the caretaker holding the package?

aliases: why is it called legacy reward
faq.answer: A mysterious benefactor left a special parcel for a seasoned adventurer at an outpost, where it waited to be collected upon arrival.
faq.q: Why is this considered a legacy reward?

aliases: is the rifle a real weapon
faq.answer: The rifle is a replica of an Ironforge air rifle, modeled after finely engineered dwarven ranged weapons rather than a frontline battle rifle.
faq.q: Is the replica rifle a functional weapon?

sections.body: The caretaker kept nothing in storage and had no wish to hold the parcel. The courier insisted you would come for it, then hurried away before the caretaker could refuse. You arrived just before the box was cast into the ocean with the evening’s refuse.
sections.title: A Package Awaiting Collection

sections.body: Inside the parcel is a Replica Ironforge Air Rifle, a tribute to the firearm craft of the dwarven capital. Dwarven mountaineers and marksmen carry deadly weapons through Dun Morogh. Replicas like this recall the intricate barrelwork and pneumatic mechanisms perfected by Ironforge craftsmen.
sections.title: Dwarven Engineering in Miniature

summary: A parcel addressed to you waited in a caretaker’s hands until you came to claim it. Inside was a Replica Ironforge Air Rifle, left by a courier whose name is unknown.
attribution: In-game quest text: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
